item.description: Archbishop Cardinal Sir John Ribat has issued a grave warning regarding the escalating HIV crisis in Papua New Guinea, revealing that an average of seven babies are born with the virus every single day across the nation. In a powerful press statement released today, the Cardinal described the situation as a "real threat" to the country’s future and called for immediate, compulsory counseling and testing for all pregnant women. item.title: Affordable ‘Kabota’ engines transform river travel in Western Province
